name: fullstack
description: One repo with api/ (kind api) + ui/ (kind nuxt-app, /api/** proxied to the API); the root gate runs both

scripts.postinstall: c=install; [ "$npm_command" = ci ] && c=ci; npm $c --prefix api && npm $c --prefix ui
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix ui
scripts.gate: npm run gate --prefix api && npm run gate --prefix ui

env.description: Where the UI server proxies /api/** to (server side only)
